name: Arcticed
source:
The blizzard has come again.
Everyone knows what this means—it is time to offer a sacrifice to the Arctic Demon.
And now, that fate has fallen upon you.
You are the Arctic Demon’s prey now.

[From [url=https://pipalapeda.itch.io/arcticed]Itch.io[/url]]

Created for Winter VN Jam 2025.
translation:
暴风雪又来了。
大家都知道这意味着什么——祭祀北极恶魔的时间到了。
而现在，命运降临到了你身上。
你现在是北极恶魔的猎物了。

[来自[url=https://pipalapeda.itch.io/arcticed]Itch.io[/url]]

专为2025年冬季VN Jam创作。
